note: v1 removes default_authority: there is NO universal default that dresses every node the same. A semantic_type resolves ONLY through its explicit per-toolkit binding; an unbound type resolves to nothing and the renderer draws the honest fallback (see visual-resolution-policy-v1.json). Bindings are per-toolkit because a semantic_type is unique to its producing toolkit — so this table IS provenance-based resolution.

bindings.justification: A Citizen/actor embodies as the energy semi-humanoid form family; hot residency is humanoid, lower residencies fall back to the energy orb.
